The '''Jolia system''' was located in the [[Eucer sector/Legends|Eucer sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] type known as the [[Jolian freighter]].<ref name="Vector">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Jolian freighter]]|system=Jolia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Jolia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-7.<ref name="TEA" />
